QuestionStmt.S: Two very long straight conductors (wires) are set parallel to each other. Each carries a current 'I' in the same direction and the separation between them is '2r'. The intensity of the magnetic field at point 'P' (as shown in the figure) ($\mu_0 =$ permeability of free space) is

Solution.S:
In the figure, magnetic field at point P is given by:

$$B_{\text{net}} = B_1 + B_2 = \frac{\mu_0 I}{2\pi} \left( \frac{1}{r} + \frac{1}{3r} \right) = \frac{\mu_0 I}{2\pi} \times \frac{4}{3r} = \frac{2}{3} \frac{\mu_0 I}{\pi r}$$

Thus the correct option is A.
